name: scottie
caption:
PICK 4 🎮🏀 Everybody wanted Suggs. We took Scottie.

• 2021 draft: we take Scottie Barnes at #4 (the consensus said Jalen Suggs)
• Rookie year: 15.3 PPG, 7.5 RPG, Rookie of the Year
• All-Star in 2024 and 2026
• This season: 23.5 PPG, 7.6 RPG, 5.1 APG

Right call at #4? 👇
